Plots could be bought during the
, though none of them worked in

mode. There were in total 16 plots that you could purchase. There were two types of plots you could buy. The first plot was the plot space, where you get rid of snow. These were cheaper and only provided ground spots. The second plot was the cliff space, where you rebuilt stone, on which you could place cliff towers. These were more expensive, but they provided new ground spots and cliff spots. Additionally, enemies and units would not travel on cliff spaces, regardless of whether they were bought or not. There were 9 plot spaces and 7 cliff spaces.
You started off with 200 base health,
passive income and 0 passive base health regeneration, which you could increase by buying plots. When all plots have been purchased, you would have 800 base health,
passive income and 72 passive base health regeneration.

Until you purchase the final plot, the game will be in an endless mode. Enemies will spawn endlessly with increasing health over time.
